rdfs:label: text
rdfs:comment: The textual content of the resource — used by Comments, Answers, Questions, and other text-bearing schema.org types.
notes: Schema.org's general-purpose text-body predicate. Distinct from `urn:solid:articleBody` (Article-specific) and `urn:solid:content` (ActivityStreams). Use on `urn:solid:Comment`, `urn:solid:Answer`, `https://schema.org/Question`, or any schema.org type that bears prose; for ActivityStreams objects (including `urn:solid:Question`, which is as:Question) use `urn:solid:content`.

history.note: Notes no longer recommend text on urn:solid:Question (as:Question uses urn:solid:content).
